intent: Address the build 152 diagnostic issue intake on the current PR and trace each report to a repair or verified prerequisite.

findings.action: Matched repeated identical inventory reads and the 75-receipt run to the existing issue-only completion repair. Verified the terminal empty-inventory path, its repository binding, and the separate evidence obligations for edits and tests.
Give a rejected blank path query an actionable filename, pattern and index lookup instruction. Preserve native validation and avoid inventing a broader query.
Matched the two session-report context failures to the retained prior-turn lookup and bounded answer continuation already on this PR.
Checked the recognizer error 10 pre-ready path, the shared restart embargo, and the documented new-input recovery. Automatic retry during the native embargo would repeat the failure.

Isolate even a single pending saved page when ordinary history displaces it. Restore original bodies only from the same journal invocation and digest. Use the actual byte cost of a measured smaller page. Keep a fresh provider completion and atomic delivery proof as prerequisites.

Verified the integrated UTF-8 note truncation and fresh-completion check. Preserve whole observations where available, recognize multilingual punctuation, and reject an oversized unbroken identifier instead of retaining a fabricated prefix.

Verified the concurrent checklist repair for rediscovering a displaced read schema and the fixture-approval preflight. Exhaustion, missing inputs and approvals remain visible as distinct unresolved test prerequisites. Request action-specific discovery only for tools whose schemas support that projection.

Reconciled the concurrent fix for feeding a full receipt projection to the Combined frozen-input planner on resume. The resumption entry point uses the original task, measured stage framing, and whole receipt rows.

Matched all three unsupported-Off probe signatures to the corrected chat-created adapter preference wiring. Auto uses the saved choice. Explicit Off on an unverified template retains its actionable preflight rejection.

Supplement the concurrent status-specific CI runs projection with shorter documentation for read contracts on tight routes. Measure the catalog plus required operations, retain schema constraints and enforce the existing output/replay reserves.

Select the lowest advertised OpenRouter reasoning effort for automatic claim extraction. Preserve explicit reasoning settings. Keep provider length failures and incomplete claim batches separate from verified output.

Return exact diagnostic lines from within the requested CI range, including a failure beyond the first sequential page. Bind their publication to the selected job, run, attempt and head. The retained run included an HTTP 504 and a failed native dependency download.

The incident had one receipt and a remaining requirement without matching proof. Surface the first named unverified requirement in partial results and preserve the verified count. Its diagnostic capsule did not record the underlying request.

qualification: Local tests exercise native contracts, bounded replay, admissible schemas, CI evidence and retained requirements. Physical handset behavior and live inference on the reporting accounts require separate verification.

focused_github_kotlin_tests.scope: Current changed sources and related app classes, using Kotlin/JVM, JUnit and retained Android dependencies.
